direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden; rows 48px Header / 52px GuideStrip / minmax(0,1fr) / 56px DecisionBar; cols 184px StepRail / minmax(0,1fr) FactoryStage / 360px EvidenceInspector at 1366x768; FactoryStage at least 55vw and 60vh, no page scroll, only inspector and task lists scroll internally
direction.colorTokens: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, silverDim rgba(197,204,212,.68), border rgba(197,204,212,.22); primary #A8F04A on #050705, one per viewport; stoppedRed #E5484D reserved exclusively for stopped CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text, preserving the required exception; official logo immutable in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect, exactly two placements: header and opening story, never recolored, cropped, redrawn or duplicated
direction.typography: System sans; 24/30 stage title, 15/20 panel title, 13/19 body, 11/14 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; tabular alignment for quantities, time and cost
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on a real state change, then static; no loops, pulses or glows; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while pattern, marker and text still carry meaning; visible focus ring on every interactive element
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo at left and Lock recovery room at right; opening story carries the second and final logo placement; StepRail generated from one steps array with aria-current, arrow-key movement and 36-40px targets; GuideStrip 52px with no duplicate primary; focusable cinematic FactoryStage SVG; EvidenceInspector 360px keeping pre-flight route-health checks for nonce and identity visually and semantically separate from the distinct investigation evidence task, never conflating their controls or status; DecisionBar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; skip-to-stage first, then header, rail, guide, SVG nodes, inspector and DecisionBar in tab order; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live=polite announces results only
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 SVG using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in neon, silver for idle machines, red only for stopped CELL-MILL-2, never a route through the offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap; bidirectional SVG-to-inspector highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted legend using pattern, marker and text; pending task proposals deliberately untracked until human approval, while blocked prior tasks remain visible beside an approved recovery plan as replacement tasks await approval

fixes.change: Enlarge Certificate 120 and Receiving 80 delta to 26px tabular metrics and anchor DOES NOT MATCH in the 40-unit gap so the discrepancy reads before machine detail.
Add bidirectional highlight: focusing ev-cert-qty or ev-recv-qty in inspector outlines the matching SVG bar and node with a 2px silver focus ring.
Trim inspector metrics to Impacted Jobs, Held-Demand Units and Feasible Paths on one baseline to reduce vertical scan inside 768px.

Separate ROUTE HEALTH - PRE-FLIGHT panel, labelled nonce and identity status, from the Investigation route select with distinct headings, borders and status text; never share one control or result state.
Refit inspector so Route health, route select and the single Run Sample investigation primary fit without pushing explanation below the DecisionBar; shorten copy to one status sentence.
Give the route select a visible focus ring and 40px height, and announce route-health result only via aria-live=polite.
Fix SELECTED badge overlapping $3,115.00 in the chosen path card; move badge to card top-right with clear space and keep cost fully legible.
Keep typed consent form clearly opened by the selection: show selected path name, plan identifier and exact phrase adjacent to the input, with character count tied to the input via aria-describedby.
Align 83h, 35h and 17.5h plus costs in tabular columns across all three path cards for instant comparison at 1366x768.
Make PROPOSED - UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL the dominant badge on each task and the 0 tracked count, so no proposal reads as tracked work.
Route the MAT-ALLOY-B 70 parts flow only through CELL-MILL-1 in neon with 40 and 30 labels that do not collide with JOB-1001 and JOB-1002 titles.
Enlarge t1 and t2 task titles to 13/19 and keep Decline proposal as a secondary text action visually below Approve in tab order.
Strengthen PREVIEW - not applied on CELL-MILL-2: dashed silver outline plus PREVIEW label, reserving solid red cross-hatch solely for the applied stopped state.
Place Will invalidate acceptance for Use verified substitute directly under the machine select with an explicit consequence line in the DecisionBar status centre.
Refit right panel so CELL-MILL-1 ONLINE and CELL-MILL-2 PREVIEW rows align capacity and rate in tabular columns.
Apply stoppedRed only to CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text; remove any red tint from Receiving so the exception stays unambiguous.
Repeat the step 2 separation: ROUTE HEALTH - PRE-FLIGHT for nonce and identity apart from the investigation task, with the 3 to 2 feasible paths change stated once above the select.
Mark Split available capacity as CONSTRAINED with pattern plus text in both SVG chip and legend, not colour alone.
Repair constrained card text overlap: wrap Split requires at least two online compatible cells on two lines clear of the INCREMENTAL label, and restore the dashed unavailable pattern.
Fix SELECTED badge clipping $3,115.00 again on the revised plan and state PRIOR ACCEPTANCE INVALIDATED once in inspector and once in DecisionBar, not repeated in stage footer.
Keep typed consent input, exact phrase and 0/27 count within the inspector viewport without scrolling at 1366x768 by tightening card padding to 12px.
Keep both groups visibly coexisting: Prior tracked work - 3 BLOCKED with names, beside Approved revised plan - replacement tasks PROPOSED - UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL, each with separate counts.
Prevent inspector scroll hiding t2: cap Britt 4.0 intro to two lines and make only the task list scroll internally with a visible scrollbar and focus ring.
Ensure SVG flow labels 40 via CELL-MILL-1 and 30 via CELL-MILL-1 sit clear of job boxes and never cross the stopped CELL-MILL-2.
Refit BEFORE-AFTER panel so 70, 35h and 48h metrics plus labels fit fully inside 768px without the clipped second row; use one 3-column tabular strip.
Separate Seal encrypted packet, Verify ledger and Export independent checkpoint into three labelled steps with independent status, keeping Verify ledger as the sole primary in DecisionBar.
Add focus ring and 40px targets to passphrase field and checkpoint actions, with passphrase guidance as one sentence.

Add opening-story completion summary panel bearing the second and final official logo placement at native aspect in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver, with no additional logo use elsewhere.
Show Complete - current ledger once per retained action and remove duplicate completion phrasing between stage footer and DecisionBar centre.
Give Recovery story complete rail item aria-current and a check marker plus text, and keep Recovery complete as a non-repeating terminal status rather than an active primary.
